$comment: The plugin recipe: every artifact a complete plugin needs, each with the wizard step that writes it, its commit layer, how it is made, the questions it needs (JSON pointers into the declaration schema, or a question this recipe declares), its template, its paths, the rule that says when it is owed, and its CHECKER: the name of one function in tools/plugin-recipe.mjs and that function's arguments, reading the real files. Plus the LAWS every plugin keeps. Read by tools/omx-new-plugin.mjs (the questions, the files it writes, the commit plan, the checklist) and by tools/plugin-recipe.mjs (`make completeness`: every plugin has every owed artifact and keeps every law). Adding a required artifact is one entry here: the wizard then writes it and the completeness test requires it of every plugin.

omxdspMin.title: omx-dsp minimum
omxdspMin.description: The first omx-dsp release that carries the kernel. Defaults to the packaging's BuildRequires.

contractRelease.title: omx-contract release
contractRelease.description: For a NEW kernel: the omx-contract release the kernel recipe cuts with data/kernels/<kernel>.json, which the pin then moves to. Leave it out to keep the pin and list the move as pending.

rules.panel: the declaration carries a panel block (a plugin with no panel yet owes no MOD GUI)
rules.byReference: the pinned omx-contract is at or past contract.byReferenceSince, the release that carries plugin parameters by reference; before it, a declaration still types its travels

steps.identity: the plugin's declaration: stem, kernel, CLAP id, LV2 URI, parameters by reference, panel
steps.kernel: the kernel the parameters reference: its file in omx-contract at the pin (by the kernel recipe in omx-contract and omx-dsp when it is new), and the pin
steps.generate: the files tools/gen.mjs and tools/modgui-gen.mjs write from the declaration
steps.faces: the build and the CLAP and LV2 faces, plain C over omx-dsp, and their binding to the kernel
steps.tests: the parameter test and the kernel-identity test
steps.packaging: the RPM and DEB file lists, the metapackage's description and CI's installed-file checks
steps.docs: the README's catalogue row and manual section, and the CHANGELOG entry

layers.what: the declarations: the plugin's own declaration
layers.message: {name}: its declaration, parameters by reference to the {kernel} kernel

layers.what: the kernel the declaration references: the omx-contract pin
layers.message: omx-contract {contractRelease}: the {kernel} kernel the plugins reference

layers.what: every file generated from the declaration
layers.message: {name}: the generated parameter header and LV2 description
{name}: CLAP and LV2 faces in plain C over omx-dsp's {kernel} kernel

layers.what: what ships and installs the plugin: the packages and their checks
the tests of the faces against the kernel
the manual, the catalogue and the changelog
layers.message: {name}: in the README's catalogue and the changelog

artifacts.what: the plugin's ONE declaration, valid against the schema, its identity unique among the plugins
the kernel's file in omx-contract at the pinned release, which the parameters reference (by the kernel recipe in omx-contract and omx-dsp when it is new); the pin moves to the release that carries it
the parameter table both faces read, generated and fresh
the LV2 bundle's manifest and plugin description, generated and fresh
the MOD GUI of the LV2 bundle, generated from the panel block and fresh
the plugin's build: all, test, gen, check, install and clean, naming the declaration's identity
the CLAP face, plain C, reading the generated table and exporting clap_entry
the LV2 face, plain C, reading the generated table and exporting lv2_descriptor
the faces reach omx-dsp's kernel: a source of the plugin includes <omxdsp/...> for it, and none is still the wizard's stub
the parameter test: make test compares the built CLAP face's parameters with the declaration
the kernel-identity test: an oracle comparing both faces with omx-dsp's kernel called directly, run by make test, not the wizard's stub
the plugin's lines in the RPM file lists: the .clap in omx-plugins-clap, the .lv2 bundle in omx-plugins-lv2
the DEB install lists cover the plugin's .clap and .lv2 bundle
the packages' descriptions name the plugin: the RPM's %description and the DEB metapackage's Description
CI's package checks expect the plugin's installed files and load them in a CLAP and an LV2 scanner
the plugin's row in the README's catalogue, with its CLAP id and LV2 URI
the plugin's section in the README: its parameters, ranges and defaults
the plugin's entry in CHANGELOG.md, the one human changelog a release copies into the packages

laws.what: plain C: no C++ source or header in the plugin
no DPF: no DISTRHO header, macro or plugin-info file
the kernel comes from omx-dsp: no engine source included, and no function omx-dsp defines defined again in the plugin
every parameter has a ref into omx-contract and retypes no travel; every ref resolves in the kernel's file at the pin
